seo.title: Miro's portfolio - Websites and web apps
seo.description: Websites and web applications built with care for design, detail, functionality, and natural use.

paragraphs: Hi, my name is Miro and I am a web developer. I create websites and web applications that I see as small digital spaces people enter for different reasons.
I combine colors, shapes, code, and empty space into a whole that should feel pleasant to look at and natural to use.
I am drawn to atmosphere, rhythm, and detail. I enjoy finding calm in complexity and bringing the essential parts forward.

contact.intro: I will be glad to hear from you with a question, an idea, or a specific request. If you are looking for someone to build a website, an app, or improve an existing solution, feel free to write. Together we can go through what you need and what the next step should be.

projects.title: Priatelia
projects.description: Priatelia is an app for meeting new people and activity partners based on interests, sympathy, and proximity. When two users like each other, the app connects them and opens a space for conversation.

projects.title: Digital archive
projects.description: Digital archive helps organize, search, and filter documents by categories, authors, and approvers. It includes a multi-level approval workflow; the demo uses simulated data.

projects.title: Yokaid
projects.description: Yokaid helps people find reliable tradespeople and professionals using a map, ratings, and real experiences from other users. Visitors quickly see who works nearby and what others have written about them.
